cuts.line: If I three putt this, I'm ending my golf career.
I'm gonna guess, in a sense, all putts are straight when you don't know how to read the green.
(topped putt) Oh my god, I topped it. I'm absolutely mortified right now.
This is gonna be a long par putt. We're all thinking it, but you got the lag master at work today.
That was gonna be terrible. I'm not even gonna watch that.
There's no reason I can't double this.
Get in, get in, get in. So it's gonna be a triple.
Too much muscle mommy for bogey.
Maybe I should quit actually. If I four putt this, call 9-1-1.
